capabilities: Reference merge requests inline (e.g. !123 or alias:!123) or in code blocks
Render live badges with state, pipeline result, approvals, and author
Configure multiple GitLab accounts for different instances with aliases and default projects
Open the merge request in the browser by clicking its badge
Cache API responses (default 15 minutes) with manual cache clearing
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README explains setup (alias, host, token, default project) and usage but not troubleshooting or limits.
intentEvidence: Modeled on obsidian-jira-issue: configure one or more GitLab accounts, then reference merge requests inline or in a code block.
problem: Obsidian notes that mention merge requests show only static text; there is no built-in way to see current merge request status.

relations.evidence: Modeled on obsidian-jira-issue: configure one or more GitLab accounts

requires.name: personal or project access token with read_api scope

summary: GitLab integration that renders merge request references as badges showing live state, pipeline result, approvals, and author in notes.
